description: This file contains functions and logic for synchronizing plugin versions and related dependencies in a project, including updating package.json files and changelogs within an extension directory.

methods.name: syncOpenClawDependencyRange
methods.description: Synchronizes the openclaw dependency version range in a dependencies record to a target version.

methods.name: syncMinHostVersion
methods.description: Synchronizes the minHostVersion in a package's openclaw install config to a target version.

methods.name: syncPluginApiVersion
methods.description: Synchronizes the pluginApi version in a package's openclaw compat config to a target version.

methods.name: syncBuildOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Synchronizes the openclawVersion in a package's openclaw build config to a target version.

methods.name: ensureChangelogEntry
methods.description: Ensures a changelog entry exists for a specific version, adding it if missing.

methods.name: syncPluginVersions
methods.description: Main function that synchronizes plugin versions across extension packages and updates changelogs.
